description: ScalewayManagedCluster is the Schema for the scalewaymanagedclusters API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: spec defines the desired state of ScalewayManagedCluster

controlPlaneEndpoint.description: ControlPlaneEndpoint represents the endpoint used to communicate with the control plane.

host.description: host is the hostname on which the API server is serving.

port.description: port is the port on which the API server is serving.

network.description: Network defines the network configuration of the managed cluster.

privateNetwork.description: PrivateNetwork allows attaching machines of the cluster to a Private Network.

id.description: Set a Private Network ID to reuse an existing Private Network.

subnet.description: Optional subnet for the Private Network. Only used on newly created Private Networks.

vpcID.description: Set the VPC ID where the new Private Network will be created.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: vpcID cannot be added or removed
id cannot be added or removed
subnet cannot be added or removed
subnet cannot be set when id is set
vpcID cannot be set when id is set

publicGateways.description:
PublicGateways allows to create Public Gateways that will be attached to the
Private Network of the cluster.

items.description: PublicGatewaySpec defines Public Gateway settings for the cluster.

ip.description: IP to use when creating a Public Gateway.

zone.description:
Zone where to create the Public Gateway. Must be in the same region as the
cluster. Defaults to the first zone of the region.

projectID.description: ProjectID in which the managed cluster will be created.

region.description: Region where the managed cluster will be created.

scalewaySecretName.description:
ScalewaySecretName is the name of the secret that contains the Scaleway client parameters.
The following keys are required: SCW_ACCESS_KEY, SCW_SECRET_KEY.
The following key is optional: SCW_API_URL.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: privateNetwork cannot be added or removed

status.description: status defines the observed state of ScalewayManagedCluster

network.description: Network contains information about currently provisioned network resources.

privateNetworkID.description: PrivateNetworkID is the ID of the Private Network that is attached to the cluster.

ready.description:
Ready denotes that the Scaleway managed cluster infrastructure is fully provisioned.
NOTE: this field is part of the Cluster API contract and it is used to orchestrate provisioning.
The value of this field is never updated after provisioning is completed.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: name must be between 1 and 63 characters
name must be a valid DNS label
